title: Notification to consumers. The
bodyText: licensee shall comply with chapter 487N, as applicable, and provide a copy of the notice sent to consumers under chapter 487N to the commissioner when a licensee is required to notify the commissioner under section 431:3B-302.
bodyHtml: [§431:3B-303]  Notification to consumers.  The licensee shall comply with chapter 487N, as applicable, and provide a copy of the notice sent to consumers under chapter 487N to the commissioner when a licensee is required to notify the commissioner under section 431:3B-302. [L 2021, c 112, pt of §2]
